statedRules.sourceClip: Paraphrased from the P89 distill corpus: board wipes are capped at 3-5; "reconsider at your 4th-5th".
Paraphrased from the P89 distill corpus: control shells use at least 8 counterspells.
Paraphrased from the P89 distill corpus: use 13-18 card-draw effects.
Paraphrased from the P89 distill corpus: proactive decks use 5-8 interaction effects.
Paraphrased from the P89 distill corpus: use 37-42 lands as the baseline.
Paraphrased from the P89 distill corpus: 28 lands is the low-curve, aggressive-mulligan exception.
Paraphrased from the P89 distill corpus: run at least 10 copies to see an effect in the opener.
Paraphrased from the P89 distill corpus: ramp 7-12 baseline, deck-dependent.
Paraphrased from the P89 distill corpus: use 8-14 removal effects.
Paraphrased from the P89 distill corpus: Bracket 2 decks use about 3 tutors.
